newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Thomas off Lihir board, Bayliss joins.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Thomas off Lihir board, Bayliss joins.

text.p: Gavin Thomas has resigned as a director of Lihir Gold Ltd and Joseph Bayliss had been elected as a director to fill the vacancy, Lihir said in a statement.

Thomas had made a major contribution to the Lihir project in Papua New Guinea and to Lihir Gold Ltd, having been personally involved in the Lihir discovery in 1982 and played a crucial role in early exploration and discovery, the company said.
Bayliss is president and chief executive of Niugini Mining Ltd, a holder of 17.15 percent of Lihir's capital.
Bayliss is also an executive officer of Battle Mountain Gold Co, which holds 50.5 percent of the outstanding shares of Niugini Mining.
